clips.title: The story
paras: Warlocks in Stormwind City use the Heartswood Core to summon a succubus. Gakin the Darkbinder provides the enchanted ritual focus, crafted from an ancient tree’s wood, to pierce the Twisting Nether and draw the demon into an arcane summoning circle.

Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter, warlocks perform rites beyond the city watch’s gaze. The Heartswood Core channels the magic needed to begin a binding ritual. Crafted from the wood of an ancient tree, it holds enough lingering magic to pierce the veil between worlds. At a consecrated summoning circle, an initiate focuses dark arts through the core and opens a passage to the Twisting Nether, drawing a succubus across the divide.
